answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the knoll of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts. Written in a game-theoretic deductions, structured causal flow with definitive takeaways register, it stays short. The reef holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
